note: Unique robot assembly components (5+9+14+20+28, + 12 for the Sorting Arm), plus a full kit for each further unit: Hoverbot #2 and #3 (28 each) and Sorting Arm #2 and #3 (12 each). Identical in every world preset; each spawns exactly once, all of them at the start. A further unit's kit waits in its type's holding tray (assembly bay) until the unit before it is operational.
